title: hard selling
body: was looking forward to using this app but i can’t even access the app because all it does is hard sell and push me into paying for the app and i can’t do anything or click out of it. i waited for 2mins thinking it’ll go away once the timer is done but then they gave me a cheaper price and i waited for another 2mins but i still can’t access the app. i tried closing and reopening the app but its still the page where they’re pushing me to pay for their service. i didn’t even get to try your app yet you’re already constantly pushing me to subscribe lol. i rarely give bad reviews on app but this is genuinely one of my worst experience.
author: angrykirby
